details.name: Description
details.value:
About Cardo

Cardo Systems is a provider of cutting-edge communication and connectivity devices and applications for powersports and outdoor enthusiasts. In 2026, Cardo is proudly unveiling its Beyond Helmet line, the first of its kind in the motorcycle industry, fostering a new age in safety, sound, and communications. After pioneering the world’s first Bluetooth-based wireless intercom headset in 2004, Cardo has been responsible for many of the industry’s innovations, revolutionizing communication, pushing technological boundaries, and enhancing user safety. Now sold in over 100 countries, Cardo is proud to be the world’s leading communication device for groups in motion.

About the Role

We are building a new B2C mobile application from the ground up and are looking for an Android Engineer to be a key player in building the app and its engineering foundation.

As the Android engineer on a new team, you will own the Android platform end-to-end and have significant influence over the application architecture, technology choices, development standards, quality strategy, and release processes. You will work closely with Product, Design, Backend, Embedded, QA, and DevOps teams, as well as the teams behind our other apps, to turn product ideas into a scalable, reliable, and high-quality mobile experience for a global user base.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional experience developing Android applications using Kotlin.
  • Proven experience building production-grade B2C mobile applications from scratch, including architecture and technology decisions, through launch and operation at scale.
  • Deep knowledge of the Android ecosystem and modern development best practices, including performance, memory management, stability, and mobile security.
  • Strong software architecture skills, with experience building modular, testable applications and reusable SDKs or libraries.
  • Strong knowledge of networking, API integration, asynchronous programming, local storage, and offline behavior.
  • Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, and UI), CI/CD, and release management in Google Play.
  • Strong ownership and collaboration skills, including taking part in architectural decisions, design, and code reviews.
  • Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal.


Advantage

  • Hands-on experience with Bluetooth Classic and BLE, including pairing, connection management, audio profiles (HFP, A2DP), and background operation (Android Bluetooth stack, foreground services).
  • Experience working with connected hardware and firmware teams, including device communication protocols and firmware updates over the air (OTA).
  • Experience with VoIP and real-time audio, including system call integration (ConnectionService / Telecom framework).
  • Experience developing AI-powered mobile features, such as conversational experiences, personalization, speech, or on-device intelligence, and integrating LLMs or machine-learning models into production apps.
  • Strong practical experience using AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering quality and productivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android UI frameworks.
  • Experience designing public SDK APIs, maintaining backward compatibility, managing semantic versioning, and supporting external developers.
  • Experience with modularization, large codebases, white-label applications, or multi-application platforms.
  • Experience with analytics, crash reporting, feature flags, and A/B testing platforms.
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform or with iOS development.
  • Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or other fast-moving product environment.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

We are looking for a dynamic and hands-on Brand Manager to lead the Spanish brand strategy while establishing and managing our social media presence in the Spanish market.

This role combines strategic brand building with in-market execution, including social media and influencer activation, retailer engagement, training, and event support. The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic self-starter with a passion for motorcycling who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves working closely with customers, both online and in person.

This position's territory will be designated for Spain and will report to the EMEA Sales Director, with a dotted line to the Digital Marketing Director.

**Please submit your CV in English**


Roles & Responsibilities:

Brand Management (50%)

  • Develop and execute the Spanish brand strategy in line with global brand guidelines.
  • Adapt global marketing assets and campaigns for the Spanish market.
  • Conduct regular retail store visits to ensure brand visibility and gather market feedback.
  • Train and educate retail partners and store teams on product USPs, brand values, and new product introductions, on Motorcycle and Outdoor.
  • Represent the brand at key trade shows, activities, and consumer and retailer events.
  • Collect real-world/end-user feedback and circulate this information internally.


Social Media & Influencers Marketing Activation (50%)

  • Lead the further development of all Spanish social media channels (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn).
  • Develop and implement a Spain-specific content calendar aligned with brand and campaign goals.
  • Collaborate with influencers, creators, and content partners to drive engagement and awareness.
  • Monitor and report performance metrics (engagement, follower growth, reach, etc.).
  • Drive local content creation, by working with content creators and shooting local content (should feel comfortable in front of a camera)
  • Localize global content and create bespoke Spanish-relevant content to grow a loyal community.
  • Manage social media budgets and paid campaigns in collaboration with marketing and digital agencies (if applicable).

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Requirements:

  • Car and Motorcycle Driving license – a must.
  • Must be an active motorcycle rider with experience.
  • Skiing experience is a plus.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English.
  • A minimum of 3 years of sales experience.
  • Experience managing social media channels.
  • Experience in working with influencers and creators
  • Experience in content creation and basic editing skills
  • Knowledge of the motorcycle and outdoor markets is an advantage.
  • Experience in developing markets & dealer channels is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Travel within the assigned region at least 50% of the time. The rest of the time, working remotely or from a home office.
  • Residency in Spain- preferably Barcelona/Madrid.


**Please submit your CV in English**

details.value:
About Cardo

Cardo Systems is a provider of cutting-edge communication and connectivity devices and applications for powersports and outdoor enthusiasts. In 2026, Cardo is proudly unveiling its Beyond Helmet line, the first of its kind in the motorcycle industry, fostering a new age in safety, sound, and communications. After pioneering the world’s first Bluetooth-based wireless intercom headset in 2004, Cardo has been responsible for many of the industry’s innovations, revolutionizing communication, pushing technological boundaries, and enhancing user safety. Now sold in over 100 countries, Cardo is proud to be the world’s leading communication device for groups in motion.


Role Description

Cardo Systems is looking for a Business Applications Specialist to join the Information Systems team.

The role serves as a key business partner for the Marketing department and is responsible for managing, developing, and improving systems and processes that support the company’s global marketing activity, digital commerce, and engineering information management.

The ideal candidate will combine business understanding, technological capabilities, and a broad engineering mindset and will lead initiatives for process improvement, automation, and the implementation of AI-based solutions in order to strengthen the organization’s business capabilities and accelerate innovation.


Responsibilities

Marketing Systems, Digital Commerce, and Artificial Intelligence

  • Serve as the Business Partner for the Marketing department for all matters related to information systems and business processes.
  • Own systems and processes that support global marketing activity, digital commerce, and customer experience.
  • Analyze business needs, define solutions, and lead their implementation in organizational systems.
  • Own the Shopify platform and the business processes supporting the company’s E-Commerce activity.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve interfaces and integrations between Shopify, marketing systems, and core organizational systems.
  • Lead projects in Marketing Technology (MarTech) and Marketing Automation.
  • Implement business automations to improve work processes and optimize marketing activity.
  • Identify and implement Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based solutions to improve business processes.
  • Define and implement Agentic AI-based processes and AI agents in the organization.
  • Promote the use of Generative AI tools for content creation, data analysis, automation, and productivity improvement.
  • Evaluate and implement new AI technologies as part of the company’s digital strategy.
  • Work with vendors, technology partners, and business stakeholders in the organization.


PLM System Management and Engineering Information Processes

  • Full ownership of the management, maintenance, and development of the organizational PLM system.
  • Lead processes that support the product lifecycle (Product Lifecycle Management).
  • Responsible for implementing new processes and improving existing processes in the system.
  • Manage, maintain, and control the quality of engineering information throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Manage and maintain product structures (BOMs) and support configuration management processes.
  • Responsible for managing and improving the Part Numbers structure and the organizational product catalog.
  • Support ECO / ECN processes and engineering changes throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Development, Operations, Purchasing, and Supply Chain departments.
  • Manage integrations and interfaces between the PLM system and additional organizational systems.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve system and process issues.
  • Evaluate opportunities to use AI capabilities to improve the quality of engineering information and product management processes.
  • Work with system vendors for maintenance, upgrades, and the implementation of new capabilities.


﻿Working as Part of the Information Systems Team

  • Work jointly with other system and application managers in the organization.
  • Participate in cross-organizational projects in the field of digital transformation.
  • Lead business improvement and optimization processes through information systems.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technology solutions.
  • Document processes, interfaces, and system solutions.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, or another relevant field.


﻿Professional Experience

  • 2-5 years of experience in information systems, business applications, or organizational system management roles.
  • Experience working with business users and leading cross-organizational processes.
  • Experience in defining, implementing, and supporting organizational information systems.


Professional Knowledge

  • Familiarity and experience working with E-Commerce platforms, with an emphasis on Shopify.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing processes and Marketing Automation systems.
  • Experience working with APIs, interfaces, and integration processes.
  • Experience in planning and implementing business automation processes.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI tools.
  • Significant advantage for experience implementing AI solutions in a business environment.
  • Experience working with product structures (BOMs).
  • Experience managing Part Numbers and engineering information frameworks.
  • Experience with PLM systems – a significant advantage.
  • Experience working with SQL, Power BI, and data analysis tools – an advantage.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, OpenAI, Zoho Platform, or similar AI platforms – an advantage.


Personal Skills

  • Business orientation alongside technological and engineering understanding.
  • Ability to lead tasks and projects end-to-end.
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability.
  • High self-learning ability and technological curiosity.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Service-oriented approach alongside the ability to drive processes.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic, multi-tasking environment.
  • Hybrid work model: 4 workdays from the office and one workday from home.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
